scope: Official-source landscape and candidate admission evidence; no new model scores or universal training-clean claims

observations: breadth-v1 has 14 public source datasets, 1990 records in each development/test partition; native and adapted metric meanings differ by source.
The manifest says several sources prohibit or do not clearly license public redistribution. Its private mirror is not a license for us to copy the entire suite.
Kev-9B version 2 was released on 2026-09-30; our previous 9B row is an earlier frozen checkpoint and must not be silently replaced.
The current Git revision matches the source already pinned in our transfer study.
Code is Apache-2.0, weights CC-BY-NC-4.0; code licensing does not confer unrestricted weight use.

Public train-source exposure is explicitly declared for 14 Decision Index sources, including ContractNLI, BANKING77 and CLINC150. They assert test items were filtered; this is source exposure, not proof of test leakage.
The Intern bundle ToolACE panel is drawn from the public ToolACE training data, not an official held-out test split.
The current Git revision matches the source already pinned in our transfer study.
Public Jevbench is disclosed as development diagnostic evidence, not an independent held-out or official complete leaderboard score.
Training and private temperature-fitting records are not published; fixed temperature presets are tied to checkpoint hashes and the XTuner backend.
The bundle calls WildJailBreak Apache-2.0, conflicting with the original publisher's current ODC-BY metadata and access gate. Upstream dataset authority controls our admission.

notes: Publisher JSON and HF plus/test are distinct representations of the official test population; HF integer OOS label is 42, not 150.
Publisher full training OOS has 100 rows; HF plus training OOS has 250. Do not claim to freeze a plus training split when using publisher data_full.json.
The HF loader script is Apache-2.0 but the dataset itself is CC-BY-4.0. Use pinned original CSV; the HF legacy script currently cannot load in modern datasets versions.

dataset_sources.gated: auto; accepting AI2 Responsible Use Guidelines and contact-information terms is required
notes: Original file access returned 403 without authenticated authorization. The vendor mirror was inspected only as evidence of adaptation; it will not be used to bypass original access conditions.
Its test collection retains source_item_id with original test/dev/train split; it is not uniformly an upstream held-out test.
The release explicitly assigns no blanket license; source URLs, citations and licensing are not consolidated.

training_exposure_evidence.notes: Absence of a published training-source list is not evidence of no exposure.

interpretation_limit: Repository stars are dated discoverability indicators, not scientific influence, adoption, or model quality. Pinning public records does not prove pretraining contamination absent. This source pass is not a human relabeling audit.
